subject: organic
question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：O'Donnell amino acid synthesis。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：BnBr, 50% aq. NaOH, Bu₄N⁺ Br⁻ (cat.), toluene。
answer: The benzophenone imine of a glycine ester is alkylated under phase-transfer conditions; hydrolysis then gives an α-amino acid.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：The monoalkylated imine is much less acidic than the starting imine, so it is neither alkylated again nor racemised. Chiral (cinchona-derived) ammonium salts make the alkylation enantioselective.
